Day 29 (old art) - March 2016 (age 13)



some fanart! as you can see I was really avoiding hands at all costs back then, that's probably why I still suck at them eee ;;

it's also kinda funny to me how I was so obsessed with having my own art style back then, convinced I didn't have one and I would never have one

oh, young-me... looking back now I can definitely see my own style developing and changing over these old drawings, that's normal! 

just like handwriting, it comes with practice

your own style is gonna develop and change over many, many years and even some masters at art can have different styles depending on what they want to draw and how they feel on any given day

it's another case of "don't be so hard on yourself, trust the process", something I'm still learning to this day
